A two-owner 2012 Honda Civic EX with a clean CARFAX and 103,222 documented miles- the kind of straightforward used compact that Northeast Ohio drivers have trusted through decades of hard winters and long commutes for good reason.

Both owners kept this Civic in Ohio throughout its life. The first owner leased it from new in 2012 and put on just over 14,000 miles per year- slightly below average. The second owner, who purchased it in 2014 and held it for over eleven years, drove even less, averaging under 6,000 miles annually. No accidents or damage of any kind has been reported to CARFAX across the full ownership history, and the title is clean- no salvage, flood, fire, or odometer issues on record. The service history spans 12 documented records, with regular oil changes and maintenance inspections performed consistently at Honda of Mentor and local shops. Four-wheel alignments were completed in 2015 and again in 2020, tires were replaced at both of those intervals, and the most recent visit March 27, 2026, just weeks before going on sale logged a maintenance inspection and recommended maintenance at Tire Choice in Painesville.

For a used Honda Civic at this price point, the ownership story here is genuinely hard to fault: two Ohio owners, no accidents, a documented service record stretching back to 2013, and an average of well under 10,000 miles per year across the vehicle's life.

The Civic EX trim adds meaningfully to the base experience- a sunroof, heated front seats, and a 7-inch touchscreen infotainment system with Bluetooth connectivity round out a cabin that holds up well for daily use. The 1.8-liter four-cylinder is a known quantity in Lake County and beyond: smooth, reliable, and easy on fuel. Whether it's a back-road run toward Geneva-on-the-Lake or the daily grind on Route 2, the Civic handles Northeast Ohio's seasons with the kind of low-drama competence that makes it easy to forget you're driving a car at all. The EX's sport-tuned suspension gives it a bit more confidence through corners than the base trim without sacrificing ride quality.
